## ConfigParseError class

Thrown when a config file's contents cannot be parsed as JSON. Mirrors the pure-TypeScript `vaultkeeper` library's `ConfigParseError`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class ConfigParseError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./wasm.vaulterror.md)
